result: Implemented focusa.mission_canvas.rich_host.hide end-to-end with explicit desktop transport path and dedicated Core lifecycle command. Hide now validates exact Workstream authority, idempotency, mission_canvas:host permission, and durable lifecycle ownership, transitions visible/focused hosts into hidden/unfocused state while preserving renderer/runtime/process/window/draft context, and emits a host_hidden composition event with projection/layout revisions unchanged. Desktop rejects stale or mismatched lifecycle responses and renderer/presentation mismatches before adopting state.

generated_contract.artifact_status: Canonical registry/openapi/client/validator contracts already contained this operation; implementation bound only destination assets.

presentation_contract.canonical_runtime: Focusa Core remains canonical lifecycle owner; Desktop is the generated rich-host renderer
presentation_contract.omitted_features: No Pi-local composition rewrite; hide preserves existing process/window/pi/canvas/last_error context and projection/layout revision behavior (unchanged revisions).

implementation: Added HostLifecycleHideCommand and exported RICH_HOST_HIDE_OPERATION in focusa-core mission_canvas module.

HostLifecycleService::hide persists hidden lifecycle state via mission_canvas_host_lifecycle with idempotency replay semantics; returns PresentationNotFound/PresentationUnavailable when lifecycle absent/unusable and idempotent repeat when same key and already hidden/focused=false.

Hide preserves all prior presentation context (process_id, window_id, drafts, renderer_resolution), increments lifecycle_revision, sets durable_event_cursor to event:pending, and emits a host_hidden composition event with payload.operation_id=focusa.mission_canvas.rich_host.hide.

API now exposes POST /v1/mission-canvas/rich-host/hide in mission_canvas router and maps generated request to HostLifecycleService::hide using mission_canvas:host permission and generated context/permission/capability extraction.
Desktop transport now includes hide-specific response validation: must receive state=hidden, focused=false, and selected_renderer=focusa_desktop_tauri before accepting HostLifecycleState.

Operation contract test now includes focused assertions for route/core/operation/transport markers, and generated consumer exercise now includes full positive/negative path coverage for missing idempotency, foreign workstream/renderer, hostile states, stale revision/cursor, and transport failures.

registry, route, generated contract, core, transport, and consumer assertions all pass
happy path + hostile mismatches/authority/transport checks for hide operation pass

acceptance: /v1/mission-canvas/rich-host/hide is implemented and reachable through generated MissionCanvasClient.rich_hostHide.
Hide transitions persisted host lifecycle to hidden/unfocused for exact Mission Canvas scope and returns HostLifecycleState with exact authority and durable lifecycle fields.
Mismatched or stale responses are fail-closed at Desktop boundary; no local composition inference or Pi-side process spawning is introduced.
